name: marketplace-dev
description: >- Builds and maintains Claude Code plugin marketplaces: converts a skills repo to spec-valid marketplace.json, adds/updates plugin entries, and migrates skills into or between suites. Use for marketplace.json, plugin distribution, one-click install, or "put these skills in a suite". Not for repo health audits (use marketplace-health-check) or cache reconciliation (use skill-governance).
